scope: Exact newly introduced native file supplier licenses; not final product SBOM/NOTICE or formal L-B acceptance.
license_facts: The registry manifest declares only Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception; no plain Apache-2.0 or MIT alternative is asserted for winx.
The full file contains the Apache 2.0 license and LLVM exceptions, including relief from Sections 4(a), 4(b) and 4(d) for portions embedded into compiled object form.

The additional GPLv2 compatibility paragraph offers a choice to waive conflicting provisions only for Combined Software in its stated circumstances. It does not require NestLink to adopt GPL or change its first-party license.
The supplier is used through unchanged Cargo library APIs. Its source and original license bytes remain in the verified source archive.
distribution_requirements: Include the original complete supplier LICENSE and any applicable notice material in the final third-party distribution inventory.
Generate and verify complete locked final-product SBOM/NOTICE before release; this review does not substitute for that gate.
Review a supplier version or license change again; the cargo-deny exception is exact-version scoped.
basis: User-authorized v3 implementation, sections 1 and 5.3: first-party Apache-2.0 with reviewed third-party suppliers retaining their own licenses.
